computer_use.description: drive local or remote desktops through the computer-mcp service: snapshots (include_ocr=true adds recognized text with physical-pixel boxes), clicks, typing, keys, scrolling, clipboard read/write, press-and-hold mouse_down/mouse_up, window/session info, accessibility trees (ax_tree/ax_act), plus OCR text tools (find_text/click_text). Pass optional host='meiva://<machine>' or host='ssh://<alias>' (omit for local; run `meiva computer list` to discover registered targets). Actions are serialized per target and audited as computer_action events
